body:
Instead of having this, maybe we need to have one board specific to prototype mode that would reuse the right stat here, instead of asking the user to double-click, we'll ask the user to press P or use the right icon to experience this as the prototype. The only thing is, we're going to need to improve the frames to be responsive and work across all types of devices so they can really experience the film switch and a device flip natively. 

Prototype should be its own board, and you should have a collaborate board that explains how we can publish easily and invite the team. They would get their own accounts, and you have pretty comments. All the comments are pinned to specific elements of your frames, and you can get mother to read them and act on them for a faster, iterative loop. 

Maybe we have a last board, but it's the thank-you board. Here you can reuse your agent, which is probably finished by now. You're going to say something cleaner, with AllFlight saying, "Hi, this is the end of the tour. Thanks for testing it out. If you were already installing it, get back to your coding agent. It will be done now, or it will ask you something."

If you're curious, consider installing Mava on either side project or your main gig and get blown away by what your coding agents are actually capable of doing. @marver

I'll start by acknowledging, then look at the current jam board and frames.
